text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests run, all OK. I didn't change anything in `tests/`. I made six fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5. The comment above it already said five.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` was returning `n + 1` events. It now returns `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma`. I made up the author and year (Austen, 1815) from the test data in `test_search.py`, because the docstring only names the title.
